title: Flea Market:
content: Woke up a little bit ago and I need to write it down before it fades because boy was it interesting. I went somewhere that seemed like it could definitely fit as a part of Mall world. This was unfortunately only part of a longer dream I’m pretty sure. The parts I remember though, I’m what seems to be an underground tunnel. As the title says, there was a flea market set up in this tunnel, and that’s one of the places I’ve heard that some people see, in place of a mall ( I don’t think anyone mentioned it being underground). Maybe I was manifesting it unconsciously but this Flea Market had vendors under a single long outdoor Canopy’s that seemed to run the whole length of the tunnel that just went off into nowhere. I kind of assumed it was underground because of how dark it was, except for single bulbs on a string that were lined up hanging from the ceiling. Some of them brushed the Canopy because it was so high to the ceiling (which was very low so it sometimes looked like the bulbs were crushed to the ceiling through the fabric). It was kind of gross because there was dirty water up to the ankles on the ground, but the people I was with didn’t seem to mind. Thankfully I don’t remember there being a bad smell to the place though. So, I was with a guy I’ve never met and do not know in real life, but in the dream, he was my buddy of 2 years. We were just browsing the long wall piled with stuff and old antiques for fun. At some point I realized that this guy had a little daughter because he took a wallet looking thing, small little case, and said to her “hey Abby I found you an old video game, you might like this” she reached for it as he handed it over but I was the one to grab it, it was like me grabbing it made that part of the dream fade and suddenly I was alone and holding this fake leather case and my friend and his daughter were nowhere to be seen. I opened it and it just looked like a cassette tape but kind of round like a disc, and I was very confused My brain literally AI’d the hell out of that and I remember trying to find something I could slide it into to see if it would work, but strangely there was no more electronics beyond maybe a hair dryer or a toaster that I could find. At some point I remember hearing talking above me and footsteps. I was still going down the tunnel wall looking at all these cool little things piled against it in ankle deep warm dirty water as wakefulness hit me like a truck. I do have to mention though that it was probably partially brought on because I watched a YouTube documentary about the Las Vegas homeless Tunnel people a couple days ago. It didn’t really look like a flea market in the real footage more like little areas here and there that people made their own, mattresses and beds with stuff on the walls. I think my brain was just combined the two, subconsciously I was still thinking about this mall world stuff and then it pulled the other most recent interesting video I watched and there was a mesh of the two.
